49279.subject: English Language
49279.question_text: In the following options lettered A to D, all the words except on have the same stress pattern. Identify the one with the different stress pattern..
49279.explanation:
Conducive: stress is on the second syllable (con-DU-cive)

Impressive: stress is on the second syllable (im-PRES-sive)

Committee: stress is on the second syllable (com-MIT-tee) 

Interesting: stress is on the first syllable (IN-ter-est-ing)

"Interesting" has the primary stress on the first syllable, while the others have primary stress on the second syllable.

49286.explanation: The correct answer is B because "Mr. Jones ALWAYS locks the back door" answers the question "Does Mr. Jones seldom lock the back door"

Does Mr. Jones always open the back door?
